findings.message: 8 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 9 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "— UM MOMENTO PARA VOCÊ" above "RELAXE. RESPIRE. CUIDE DE VOCÊ."; "EXPERIÊNCIA ESSENZA" above "Mais do que uma massagem. Um momento par"; "CUIDADO EM CADA TOQUE" above "Encontre o momento certo para você."; "O CONFORTO DE ESTAR EM CASA" above "Seu bem-estar, onde você estiver."; "PEQUENOS RITUAIS, TODOS OS DIAS" above "Leve o bem-estar para casa."
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "01", "02", "03"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 13 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "— UM MOMENTO PARA VOCÊ", "ATENDIMENTO", "EXPERIÊNCIA ESSENZA", "EXPERIÊNCIA ESSENZA").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 2 gradient fill(s): section#experiencias.experience.reveal → linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(35, 26, 18, 0.91), rgba(35, 26, 18, 0.376) 63%, rgba(35, 26, 18, 0.063)), url("htt | section.final-cta.reveal → radial-gradient(rgb(230, 218, 201), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 65%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 2 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.float-card.top → rgba(53, 36, 25, 0.063) 0px 10px 35px 0px | div.float-card.bottom → rgba(53, 36, 25, 0.063) 0px 10px 35px 0px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: Buttons with shadow/glow.
findings.fix: Flat fill, one colour.

findings.message: 9 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): div.service-meta 312px | div.service-meta 312px | div.service-meta 312px | div.service-meta 312px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 2 backdrop-blur surfaces.
findings.fix: One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.

findings.message: Yellow-cream background (page background #f5f1ea, section #e8e3d8).
findings.fix: Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "O CONFORTO DE ESTAR EM CASA" 4:1 needs 4.5:1; "Não precisa sair de casa. Preparamos tud" 4:1 needs 4.5:1; "Região: [Cidade e região de atendimento]" 4:1 needs 4.5:1; "ESPAÇO PARA A FOTO DO PROFISSIONAL" 4:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 13px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 86 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: 1 text block(s) sit within 16px of the screen edge: "Pular para o conteúdo" (15px from the left)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–32px or more). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.

findings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 11 different lines (65px, 108px, 129px, 509px, 749px, 801px, 953px); the three most used hold only 56% of it.
findings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.

findings.message: Little motion: 8 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Give every section an entrance for its parts (not one fade of the whole block) and add one moving picture: a looping clip or a slow move on a photograph.
